name: seo-audit
description: SEO audit, website audit, technical SEO, on-page SEO and ecommerce SEO for your own site, Shopify or online store, WordPress site or blog. Use it when pages are not indexed or not showing up on Google, organic traffic dropped after a relaunch or platform move, you have a Search Console or crawler export to read, you want to know what to fix first, or an agency or tool sent a list of SEO issues and you need to know which ones matter. Also checks one page's title and description, and a site's source code for noindex, sitemap and canonical mistakes. Audit findings show their evidence; fixes become a ranked plan with developer tickets.

interface.longDescription: Five connected skills for SEO work: audit a site or a section, audit one page against a target query, analyze Search Console and crawler exports with fixed thresholds, review a site's source code and report issues as file:line, and turn findings into developer tickets with acceptance criteria. Every finding states its evidence and whether it was observed, read from your data, or still needs a check in a named tool. The plugin itself runs no code and stores nothing.
defaultPrompt: Review this Next.js project for SEO problems and list them as file:line.
Here are my Search Console queries and query-by-page exports. Find striking-distance queries, CTR outliers and cannibalization.
Run an SEO audit of https://example.com. B2B SaaS; the goal is more demo requests from organic search.
